name: Arbran I
description: Arbran I was a rocky, moonless planet that orbited the star Arbran. It was the innermost planet in the Arbran system, which was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
lead_paragraphs: Arbran I was a rocky, moonless planet that orbited the star Arbran. It was the innermost planet in the Arbran system, which was located in the Bon'nyuw-Luq sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories.
